in_marathi.name: Lukesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lukesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Hindi word ‘lukh’ which means ‘to bring’ and ‘ish’ which means ‘light’ or ‘god’. The name Lukesh signifies a bringer of light, illuminating the path and guiding one towards the divine.
